role: Extension of MorningReanalysisControls holding the morning-results analysis-window picker (automatic methods + manual 'Choose Window'), live and persistent auto-vs-chosen comparison banners, the overnight strap re-merge card, provenance rows, PDF/email report rendering and the RR CSV export; plus file-scope view helpers.
types: MorningReanalysisControls: extension — window-method/manual-window/strap-merge/report-export UI and actions (struct declared in MorningReanalysisControls.swift)
MorningReanalysisControls.ReportInputs: struct (private) — value-type bundle of sleep/sleepTrend/HK HR/vitals/composite/breakdown/baseline/live load/recent sessions passed to the detached PDF render
toplevel: File-scope private helpers persistentScoreDiffColumn/rmssdColumn/comparisonColumn/provenanceRow/rrExportRows sit outside the extension (lines 858-945); no global state.

units.does: Builds the 'Analysis Window' card: header, method menu + Choose Window button, tooltip, live manual comparison banner, manual pick rejection message, persistent auto-vs-yours banner, and provenance rows, on a tinted rounded background.
units.entry: SwiftUI view property; rendered via MorningResultsView.windowSelectionMethodSection (MorningResultsView+ReanalysisForwarding.swift:31) from interChartSections when vm.hasRawData and onReanalyze != nil; also rendered directly by EmuquTests/UncoveredScreenSnapshotTests.swift:225.

units.does: Caption text with the tooltip of the custom method when manual mode is on, else of vm.selectedMethod.

branches.effect: true: WindowSelectionMethod.custom.tooltip ('Tap or drag on the chart…'); false: vm.selectedMethod.tooltip

units.does: Static header row: 'scope' glyph and localized 'Analysis Window' title.
HStack of the method dropdown menu and the Choose Window button.
SwiftUI Menu whose items are windowMethodOptions and whose label is windowMethodMenuLabel.
One Button per WindowSelectionMethod.automaticMethods (Best Recovery, Highest RMSSD/SDNN/Total Power) labelled with displayName/icon; tapping calls selectWindowMethod(method).

On a different method: sets vm.selectedMethod, persists it as the global defaultWindowSelectionMethod in SettingsManager.settings (didSet -> save to user_settings.json), leaves manual mode, clears manualResult, and re-runs analysis with that method.

branches.effect: true: return without doing anything; false: apply and reanalyze

units.does: Bordered dropdown label: icon + name of the custom window when in manual mode, else the selected method's icon/shortName, chevron, and an accessibility label naming the method.

branches.effect: accessibility label names 'Custom Window' when true, else the selected method's shortName

units.does: Shows the 'Choose Window'/'Exit' button only when an onReanalyzeAt callback was supplied; tapping toggles manual window mode.

branches.effect: true: render the button; false: render nothing (no manual picking for this caller, e.g. ImportDataView)

units.does: Toggles isManualWindowMode; when it turns off, clears the preview manualResult.

branches.effect: true: manualResult = nil; false: keep it

units.does: Pill label 'Choose Window' (tinted) or 'Exit' (primary-filled, white text) depending on manual mode.
Live preview comparison banner, shown only in manual mode once a manual result exists.
Warning row showing manualPickMessage (pick rejected / apply failed) while in manual mode.

branches.effect: true: gold warning row with the message; false: nothing

units.does: Card offering to pull the strap's full-night recording for a streaming-only overnight: header, explanatory text, status message and pull button.
units.entry: SwiftUI view property; rendered via MorningResultsView.overnightStrapMergeCard from dataSourceSection when dataSourceSummary.selectedSource == "streaming".

units.does: Static header: heart-download glyph and 'Merge full night from strap'.
Shows strapMergeMessage text when set.
Button that calls mergeOvernightFromStrap; disabled while strapMergeWorking.

Sets strapMergeWorking, clears the message, then asynchronously asks the collector to reconnect to the strap, pull its stored overnight recording, merge and re-score the session; on .merged reloads the full session into vm.reanalyzedSession; finally clears the working flag and shows an outcome message.

branches.effect: true: await showMergedSession(sessionId); false: skip reload

units.does: Loads the full archived session (with rrSeries) off-main and assigns it to vm.reanalyzedSession so merged beats/data-source summary appear even if the archive observer skipped the reload.

branches.effect: true: return silently (screen keeps pre-merge session while the message still says 'Merged'); false: assign

units.does: Maps an OvernightAugmentResult to a localized user message.

branches.effect: merged: beats count, plus recovery score when present
true: 'Merged — N beats.'; false: 'Merged — N beats, recovery S.' with S = safeDisplayScore(score*10)
'This night already includes the strap recording.'

units.does: Full-width sage button label: spinner + 'Pulling from strap…' while working, else 'Pull from strap & merge'.
Persistent 'Your Window vs Auto' banner shown on a session whose window the user adjusted and that kept the auto window result.
Static header row 'Your Window vs Auto'.
Three columns separated by 56 pt dividers: Auto (autoWindowScore, auto RMSSD), Yours (displaySession.recoveryScore, displayResult RMSSD), and the score diff.
Column with title, the display score ScoreVerdict.safeDisplayScore(score*10) (clamped 0–100, non-finite → 0; or '—' when nil), 'Score' caption and rounded RMSSD in ms.

branches.effect: clamped display score in app locale; else —

units.does: Live 'Comparing Windows' banner with Auto/Yours/Diff RMSSD columns and the Apply/Cancel actions for a previewed manual window.

The Auto column's result: displaySession.autoWindowResult while the night carries a manual pick (windowUserAdjusted == true) and one was kept; otherwise vm.displayResult, which follows a method switch (that clears windowUserAdjusted but leaves the old autoWindowResult).
HStack of rmssdColumn(Auto, autoComparisonResult), 50 pt divider, rmssdColumn(Yours, manual), divider, diffColumn.
Signed RMSSD delta (manual − auto) column, sage when >= 0 else terracotta, footnoted with the manual window's classification short label.

branches.effect: true: its shortLabel; nil/unknown raw value: fallback manual.displayWindowClassification (may be nil -> no footnote)

units.does: Shows Apply/Cancel buttons only when an onApplyManualResult callback exists.

branches.effect: true: buttons; false: preview only, no way to persist the pick

units.does: Cancel (clears manualResult and manualPickMessage) and Apply (applyManualWindowChoice) buttons, both disabled while vm.isReanalyzing.
Static 'Cancel' pill label.
'Apply' pill label with a spinner while reanalyzing, else a checkmark.

branches.effect: true: white ProgressView; false: checkmark icon

units.does: Logs old/new RMSSD and score, sets isReanalyzing, then awaits onApplyManualResult(manual) (callers wire RRCollector.applyManualAnalysis -> ReanalysisService, which starts from the current archived copy of the session, sets windowUserAdjusted, rescores and re-archives) and finishes on the MainActor.
calls: closure:onApplyManualResult — set by HistoryView (collector.applyManualAnalysis) and RecordView+Sections (applyManualMorningResult)

branches.effect: log 'nil' instead of the formatted score

units.does: On success puts the updated session into vm.reanalyzedSession, clears manualResult and exits manual mode; on nil shows an apply-failed message; always clears isReanalyzing.

branches.effect: true: adopt session, clear preview, exit manual mode, log; false: manualPickMessage='Couldn't apply this window…', log failure

branches.cond: recoveryScore / analysisResult / windowUserAdjusted nil inside log

units.does: Full-screen dimmed overlay with spinner and 'Generating PDF...'.
VStack of the window and segment provenance rows.
'Window: start – end' row using wall-clock times from the RR series for the result's windowStartMs/EndMs.

branches.cond: windowStartMs, windowEndMs and displaySession.rrSeries all non-nil
branches.effect: true: row; false: nothing (lightweight session before hydration shows no window row)

units.does: 'From: <segment>' row when the result names an analysis segment.

Computes which PDF sections have data: always hrvSummary; overnightStats if raw RR and overnight; sleep if HK sleep minutes > 0; trainingLoad if training context/snapshot; vitals if reportVitals exist; scoreBreakdown if composite > 0; charts and deepDive if raw RR.
Vitals for the report: for a historical session the frozen session.vitalsSnapshot, else live vm.recoveryVitals; for today's session the live vitals. Shared by the section picker and reportInputs.
Sets vm.isGeneratingPDF, then in a Task renders the PDF (renderPDFAsync) and hands the URL to finishExportPDF on the main actor with onFailure.
units.entry: Report section picker's onGenerate, via the MorningResultsView forwarder

units.does: Clears vm.isGeneratingPDF; with a URL sets exportURL (opening the PDF preview sheet); without one calls onFailure with reportFailureMessage so the user is told the render failed.
Localized 'Couldn't generate the recovery PDF. The session may not have enough data.'
Sets vm.isGeneratingEmailPDF, then in a Task renders the PDF (renderPDFAsync) and hands the URL to finishEmailPDF on the main actor with onFailure.
units.entry: Report section picker's onGenerate, via the MorningResultsView forwarder

units.does: Clears vm.isGeneratingEmailPDF; with a URL sets emailURL (opening the mail composer); without one calls onFailure with reportFailureMessage so the user is told the render failed.
Builds the export session, fetches HealthKit HR stats, gathers report inputs on the MainActor, renders the PDF on a detached task, logs timing and file size, returns the temp-file URL or nil.

branches.effect: log failure and return nil; else continue

units.does: Copies vm.displaySession and attaches vm.displayResult as analysisResult, filling a missing trainingContext from the session's trainingSnapshot.
Queries HealthKit HR stats from session.startDate to endDate (fallback start + duration or 8 h) and logs timing; returns nil on error.

branches.effect: log warning, return nil (report renders without HK nadir)

units.does: Gathers report inputs on the MainActor: vitals (reportVitals), HK sleep and sleep trend (only when non-empty), HK HR, composite score, breakdown, baseline stats, freshly recomputed live training load, recent sessions.

branches.effect: SleepTrendData (AnalysisSleepTrendInput) from the stats; else nil

units.does: Runs PDFReportGenerator().generateReportURL off the main actor with the session and inputs; returns the temp PDF URL or nil.
Re-runs analysis on the displayed session with vm.selectedMethod via the onReanalyze callback and applies the result.
units.entry: Re-analyze confirmation dialog action (MorningResultsView.reanalyzeActions via forwarding).
calls: closure:onReanalyze — set by RecordView+Sections (collector.reanalyzeSession) and HistoryView (forwarded onReanalyze)

units.does: Same as performReanalysis but with an explicit method.
Adopts a non-nil reanalyzed session into vm.reanalyzedSession and clears isReanalyzing.

branches.effect: true: assign; false: keep current session (declined: no RR data / analysis failed / persist failed) with no user message

units.does: Sets isReanalyzing, clears the pick message and asks onReanalyzeAt for an analysis at the tapped timestamp; result goes to finishManualPreview.
units.entry: Chart tap in manual mode (OvernightChartsView onReanalyzeAt closure set in MorningResultsView.overnightChartsSection).
calls: closure:onReanalyzeAt — collector.reanalyzeAtPosition(session, targetMs:) from RecordView+Sections / HistoryView

units.does: Stores the preview result and clears the message, or sets a 'too many irregular beats' message; clears isReanalyzing.

branches.effect: true: manualResult = newResult; false: manualPickMessage set (same text for any failure, including missing RR on disk)

units.does: Writes the displayed session's RR series as a CSV (rrExportHeader provenance comments + rrCSVRows) to tmp under rrExportFilename and sets exportURL to preview/share it (MorningResultsView deletes the file when the sheet closes). With no series, or when the write throws, logs and calls onFailure with 'Couldn't create the CSV file.'
units.entry: Export RR button, via the MorningResultsView forwarder

units.does: Builds the '#'-comment CSV header: session date, series start, point count, duration, and when an analysis exists its window indices, window ms (-1 if nil) and RMSSD.

branches.effect: true: add window/RMSSD lines; false: omit

units.does: Filename 'Emuqu_RR_<yyyy-MM-dd_HHmm>.csv' from displaySession.startDate using a POSIX Gregorian formatter.
Score-diff column: the difference of the two displayed scores, safeDisplayScore(yours*10) − safeDisplayScore(auto*10), formatted '%+d', sage if >= 0 else terracotta; '—' when either score is missing.
Comparison column for one window: localized title, RMSSD '%.1f', footnote with the window mean HR in bpm when known.
Generic column: title, value, 'RMSSD' unit, optional footnote.
1 pt wide tertiary (30%) vertical rule of the given height between comparison columns (56 pt in the persistent banner, 50 pt in the live comparison).
Glyph + caption row used for provenance.
The 'timestamp_ms,rr_ms,hr_bpm' header and one row per beat; hr is 60000/rr_ms with one decimal in the POSIX locale, empty for rr_ms ≤ 0. Internal so every RR CSV export can share one row format.
